title: The Poincaré conjecture in Lean 4: the frenzymath formalization, built and checked

contributors.name: Bhattacharjee, Deep
contributors.affiliation: Formerly, Electro-Gravitational Space Propulsion Laboratory (EGSPL), Bhubaneswar, Odisha 751030, India

description:
A complete Lean 4 and Mathlib formalization of the smooth and topological Poincaré theorems, following Morgan and Tian's account of the Hamilton–Perelman proof, copied unchanged from frenzymath/PoincareConjecture at commit 62db01a (Apache-2.0) and described in arXiv:2610.08329 by its authors, who are the creators of this record. The theorems state that every compact, simply connected 3-manifold without boundary is homeomorphic to the unit sphere of ℝ⁴, and diffeomorphic to it when smooth.

The archive adds an independent check: a static scan of all 23,559 proof files (3,061,741 lines) finding no sorry, axiom, native_decide or other escape hatch; a statement audit against the Comparator challenge; a chained CI build with #print axioms and a leanchecker kernel replay; and C, C++, Julia and Python (Regina) checks of the objects in the theorem: the homology of a triangulated 3-sphere, the binary icosahedral group of the Poincaré homology sphere, and Ricci flow on the round 3-sphere.
notes: The formalization is by the creators listed (frenzymath/PoincareConjecture); per-file notices are kept in the Lean files, NOTICE and MODIFICATIONS.md. The checks in verification/ and checks/ were added by Deep Bhattacharjee (d.bhattacharjee@erl-forschung.de; itsdeep@live.com) under the MIT licence.
